verdict.rationale: Airbyte provides a Connection Timeline that shows historical sync events and can chain dbt Cloud transformations after a sync, giving partial traceability of pipeline steps, but there is no evidence of an actual lineage graph, column-level lineage, or a unified view connecting sources, transformations, and destination tables. missing for 10: dedicated lineage visualization/graph feature, column-level lineage tracking, integration with lineage tools (e.g., OpenLineage), cross-tool lineage spanning dbt transformations.
